name: RZText::IsLeadByte
notes: Hooked (as a whole-register answer). Every byte value 0..0x1ff in 16 code pages, and random byte / page pairs. Also exercised through GZFont_Text (cGZFont's text slots). Mutation check (tools/mutate.py, 2026-10-27, 27 mutants of src/rz/RZTextChars.cpp): 24 killed; 3 equivalent: CharLength without the UTF-16 shortcut (page 16 names no double-byte page, so it answers 1 as well), `length < 1` for `length <= 1` before the second UTF-8 byte (the result is clamped to the length either way), and CharsLength stepping one byte per unit for UTF-16 (CharLength never reads a UTF-16 unit). The first run left the system-code-page lookup unkilled: the test now presets the global to a double-byte page too.
